instruction: Open Apple Notes and create a note with the title "Daily Reminder". Set the body to "Remember to review the plan tonight.".
reference_command:
cat > /tmp/memo_auto_add.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
file="$1"

cat > "$file" <<'TXT'
Daily Reminder

Remember to review the plan tonight.
TXT
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/memo_auto_add.sh
EDITOR=/tmp/memo_auto_add.sh memo notes --folder "Work" --add

parameters.note_content: Remember to review the plan tonight.
